info.title: AetherMint API
info.description: Decentralized education platform API built on the Stellar blockchain. Provides endpoints for authentication, course discovery, enrollment, payments (Stellar XLM & fiat), quizzes, real-time collaboration, federated learning, quantum-resistant encryption, and swarm intelligence.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token obtained from POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/register

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Static API key for server-to-server integrations

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details object returned by every AetherMint API endpoint on error. The Content-Type is `application/problem+json`.

type.description: Stable URI identifying the problem class. Each code maps to exactly one type — see the Error Catalog.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the *kind* of problem. Stable across occurrences.

status.description: HTTP status code. Always matches the response status.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence (method + path).

code.description: Machine-readable AetherMint error code (catalogued in ERROR_CATALOG.md).

success.description: Always `false` for an error response. Preserved for existing clients.

requestId.description: Correlation id; matches the `X-Request-ID` response header.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp captured when the response was composed.

error.description: Legacy `{success:false, error:{…}}` mirror retained for backward compatibility.

CursorPagination.description: Cursor-based pagination metadata returned by list endpoints. Pass `cursor` as a query parameter to fetch the next page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when on the last page.

Job.description: A background job processed asynchronously by the job queue.

JobStats.description: Aggregate statistics for the background job queue.

description.example: A beginner-friendly course on blockchain fundamentals.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by all error handlers.

recipientAddress.description: Stellar wallet address of the recipient

txHash.description: Stellar transaction hash for the on-chain issuance

totalSizeSaved.description: Total bytes saved via holographic compression
